description: A deterministic Phaser 3 escape-ray puzzle with a warm mechanical-garden board, replayable local seeds, verified solution witnesses, pause, zoom, recovery, and complete wallet-free guest play. GameFi, rewards, VRF, and TEE remain disabled until a real deployed service path is verified.
